auth: 1. Tenant creates a developer account + keyset (client id / secret) and grants the user token via the authorization-code flow (scopes sell.inventory, sell.fulfillment, sell.account, sell.analytics).
2. Client refreshes the user token with Basic client_id:client_secret (`self.refreshed` persisted by the executor).

sandbox.notes: eBay Sandbox: a Sandbox keyset (App ID / Cert ID from developer.ebay.com > Application Keys, Sandbox column) and a refresh token from a consent given by a Sandbox test user at auth.sandbox.ebay.com. Hosts from eBay's own OAuth clients (environment.SANDBOX in eBay/ebay-oauth-python-client oauthclient/model/model.py and eBay/ebay-oauth-java-client Environment.java: api.sandbox.ebay.com, https://auth.sandbox.ebay.com/oauth2/authorize, https://api.sandbox.ebay.com/identity/v1/oauth2/token); developer.ebay.com answers 403 to non-browser clients. Scope URIs are unchanged: eBay's client test GetUserAccessToken.py requests https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.* against SANDBOX. The token endpoint answered invalid_client to a dummy client on 2026-09-27.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Production keyset App ID (Client ID) from developer.ebay.com > Application Keys; sent with the Cert ID as HTTP Basic on the token call.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: User refresh token (v^1.1#...) from a one-time authorization-code consent that granted at least sell.inventory, sell.fulfillment and sell.account (the refresh request re-asks exactly these scopes, which must be a subset of the consent); long-lived (about 18 months), revoked when the seller changes password. 2-hour user access tokens are minted from it.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Currency of your listings' marketplace (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR); needed only by update_listing, since eBay prices are {value, currency} objects.

me.note: GET /sell/account/v1/privilege (scope sell.account) returns {sellerRegistrationCompleted, sellingLimit{amount, quantity}} for the seller the refresh token belongs to.

update_listing.note: POST /sell/inventory/v1/bulk_update_price_quantity {requests: [{offers: [{offerId, availableQuantity, price{value, currency}}]}]} revises price and/or quantity of one published offer (listing_id = the Inventory API offerId). price.value is sent as the documented decimal string and price.currency comes from the `currency` config field — pass `price` whenever currency is configured. `title`/`description` are not changed (they live on the inventory item, whose PUT replaces the whole record). eBay answers 200 with a per-offer statusCode and errors[] under responses[]: check raw.statusCode (200 = applied).

end_listing.note: POST /sell/inventory/v1/offer/{offerId}/withdraw ends the single-variation listing of the offer; the offer object stays (unpublished) and can be republished. Returns {listingId, warnings}. deleteOffer is not used.

set_inventory.note: POST /sell/inventory/v1/bulk_update_price_quantity {requests: [{sku, shipToLocationAvailability{quantity}}]} sets the inventory item's total ship-to-home quantity (flows to its published offers). `sku` is required (the Inventory API keys items by SKU; listing_id is not used). Per-item statusCode / errors come back 200 under responses[] (see raw).

list_orders.note: GET /sell/fulfillment/v1/order?limit(max 200, default 50)&offset (scope sell.fulfillment) returns {total, orders[{orderId, orderFulfillmentStatus NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS|FULFILLED, pricingSummary.total{value, currency}, creationDate}]} for up to the last 2 years. `since` and `status` are ignored: eBay filters through one composed `filter` string (creationdate:[<ISO>..],orderfulfillmentstatus:{NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS}) that the adapter cannot assemble. `total` is the decimal string eBay returns.

not_offered.create_listing: Needs a three-call chain: PUT /sell/inventory/v1/inventory_item/{sku} {product{title, description, imageUrls[]}, condition, availability{shipToLocationAvailability{quantity}}} (Content-Language header), then POST /sell/inventory/v1/offer {sku, marketplaceId, format: FIXED_PRICE, pricingSummary{price{value, currency}}, listingPolicies{fulfillmentPolicyId, paymentPolicyId, returnPolicyId}, merchantLocationKey, categoryId} returning offerId, then POST /sell/inventory/v1/offer/{offerId}/publish — the runtime maps one verb to one call.
not_offered.mark_shipped: POST /sell/fulfillment/v1/order/{orderId}/shipping_fulfillment requires lineItems[{lineItemId, quantity}] (the order's own line-item ids, read with GET /sell/fulfillment/v1/order/{orderId} first) besides shippingCarrierCode and trackingNumber — two calls.
not_offered.listing_metrics: Sell Analytics getTrafficReport (GET /sell/analytics/v1/traffic_report, scope sell.analytics.readonly; page not re-read this pass) takes dimension=LISTING and a composed filter string (marketplace_ids:{EBAY_US},date_range:[yyyymmdd..yyyymmdd],listing_ids:{id}) that the adapter expressions cannot assemble.

evidence: host api.ebay.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Sectigo Limited)
